steps.caption: Open Today from the sidebar. It is your start page every morning.
Getting started tracks the set-up steps still left, with a button for the next one.
Today's schedule: every meeting with its time, place and whether the brief is ready.
Priority tasks & follow-ups: what to do today, most urgent first.
Overdue commitments: promises that slipped past their date.
Recommended next actions: the most urgent things first, each with the reason.
Active transactions: deals in offers, approvals or execution, and what blocks them.
Pending approvals: changes waiting in Review before they touch your records.
Important lease events: notice deadlines and expiries coming up, so nothing is missed.
Priority accounts: the companies most worth calling, with their score and why.
Open All tasks to start working through them.
It opens in Tasks, where you complete it, snooze it or see what it is linked to.
